name: パワースペクトル密度
description: 分析します the power スペクトル slope in the 周波数領域. Natural images follow a characteristic 1/f power law while AI images deviate from this パターン.
mechanism: Computes 2D FFT power スペクトル and 分析する radial averages. Deviations from the natural 1/f power law indicate AI generation.
parameters: FFT size: 適応型, Averaging: radial, Metric: spectral slope
useCase: 自然な1/fパワー則からのスペクトル逸脱の検出

references.title: Torralba, A. & Oliva, A. (2003). Statistics of Natural Image Categories. Network: Computation in Neural Systems.
Field, D.J. (1987). Relations Between Statistics of Natural Images and Response Properties of Cortical Cells. JOSA-A.
van der Schaaf, A. & van Hateren, J.H. (1996). Modelling the Power Spectra of Natural Images. Vision Research.

strengths:
• Reveals fundamental frequency-domain characteristics
• Natural images follow predictable 1/f power law
• AI deviations from 1/f are distinctive markers
• Fast computation via FFT
• Content-independent 分析 approach
limitations:
• Heavy JPEG圧縮 alters spectral characteristics
• Small images have limited frequency 解像度
• Some AI models trained to match natural PSD
• Windowing effects can introduce spectral leakage
• Post-processing changes spectral profile
